deck_structure: Treat packages 7016 and 7040 as one integrated player game plan and one briefing deck.

campaign_history.player_facing_summary: SA-10 South was destroyed during the previous mission. SA-10 East and SA-10 West remain active and are still shaping the Gimhae fight.

named_points.label: TIG
named_points.name: Tiger
named_points.meaning: Low-altitude flow / southwest fallback and retrograde anchor.

named_points.label: CRO
named_points.name: Crown
named_points.meaning: Low-altitude crossing / southern work area anchor.

named_points.label: WWO
named_points.name: Wolf
named_points.meaning: Southeast pop-up / CAP anchor for package 7040.

named_points.label: BAN
named_points.name: Bando
named_points.meaning: Alternate pop-up CBU attack reference for SA-10 East.

packages.briefing_read: Low-altitude Gimhae / SA-10 West attack package. Jaguar 4 kills SA-10 West from Blues and attacks any surviving air-defense or parked-aircraft opportunity around Orion/Gimhae. Panther 1 strikes Orion/Gimhae while Hawkeye 2 escorts Jaguar 4, Jaguar 5 escorts Panther 1, and Sawbuck 2 provides high-altitude AMRAAM pressure between Tiger and Crown against fighters launching from Gimhae.

strike_contracts.intent: Flow low with the package from Tiger past Crown, attack Orion/Gimhae, and retrograde southwest toward Tiger once the SA-10 West and SA-10 East problems are solved.

sad_contracts.intent: Flow from Tiger nap-of-the-earth past Crown, use Blues as the IP, then destroy SA-10 West with HARMs/CBUs. If able, prosecute any remaining air defenses or aircraft on top of Orion/Gimhae.

cap_contracts.intent: Protect Jaguar 4 through the low-altitude SA-10 West attack.
Protect Panther 1 during ingress, Orion/Gimhae attack, and initial egress.
Work high around Tiger to Crown and shoot AMRAAMs at bandits coming out of Gimhae/Orion before they pressure the low-altitude strikers.

target_opportunities.label: 10W
target_opportunities.name: SA-10 West
target_opportunities.intent: Jaguar 4 primary SEAD/DEAD target from Blues.

target_opportunities.label: ORO
target_opportunities.name: Orion / Gimhae
target_opportunities.intent: Panther 1 primary strike target; Jaguar 4 may attack additional air defenses or parked aircraft on top of Orion/Gimhae if able.

packages.fallback_logic: After SA-10 West, SA-10 East, and Orion/Gimhae are destroyed or the package is forced off, retrograde southwest toward Tiger, return to medium altitude, and RTB.

packages.briefing_read: Low-altitude SA-10 East attack package from Gunsan. Hammer 2 crosses Crown low, then pops from Wolf to attack SA-10 East at short range with HARMs; if unable, Hammer 2 uses Bando for a pop-up CBU attack. Devil 5 and Devil 6 cap around Wolf and intercept bandits from the north or north-northeast.

sad_contracts.intent: Cross Crown low, pop from Wolf to shoot SA-10 East at short range with HARMs, and if unable execute the Bando pop-up CBU option.

cap_contracts.intent: CAP around Wolf and intercept fighters from the north or north-northeast.
Support Devil 5 around Wolf and intercept fighters from the north or north-northeast.

target_opportunities.label: 10E
target_opportunities.name: SA-10 East
target_opportunities.intent: Hammer 2 primary target from Wolf, with Bando as the alternate pop-up CBU reference.

packages.fallback_logic: Once SA-10 East, SA-10 West, and Orion/Gimhae are solved, retrograde southwest toward Tiger, return to medium altitude, and RTB.

commander_intent: Two player packages reopen the Gimhae fight by killing the remaining SA-10 West and SA-10 East threats while striking Orion/Gimhae. Low-altitude strike/SEAD elements preserve survivability against the SA-10s, while F-15 screens and escorts prevent Gimhae and northern threat axes from disrupting the attack.

check_in.call: Bullseye or tactical anchor as required

notes: Example: Sentry, Panther 1, checking in as fragged, request ALPHA CHECK BULLSEYE.
Use one ABM picture for both player packages; cross-package calls go to ABM, not package tactical.

priority.notes: A live engagement owns the net.
Target killed, unable, abort, package timing, or lane deconfliction.
Intra-package target sorting and prosecution updates.

deconfliction: Package 7016 flows low from Tiger past Crown toward Blues/Orion.
Package 7040 flows low from Gunsan toward Crown, then Wolf/Bando for SA-10 East.
Sawbuck 2 works high around Tiger-Crown to pressure Gimhae-origin fighters.
Devil 5 and Devil 6 work around Wolf against north/north-northeast fighters.
All player elements retrograde southwest toward Tiger after the SA-10 East, SA-10 West, and Orion/Gimhae objectives are solved.
